requirements.statement: A user can sign in to the app so their todos are private and available across visits

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is directed to sign in before seeing any todos
After signing in, a user sees their own todos, not any other user's
A user's todos persist and are visible again after signing out and back in

requirements.statement: A user can add a new todo with a title

criteria.must: Submitting a title creates a new todo in the caller's list
A newly added todo starts as not complete

requirements.statement: A user can see all of their todos in one list

criteria.must: The todo list screen shows every todo belonging to the signed-in user

requirements.statement: A user can mark a todo complete and reopen it

criteria.must: Marking a todo complete updates its status to complete
Reopening a completed todo updates its status back to not complete

requirements.statement: A user can edit a todo's title

criteria.must: Editing a todo's title saves the new title and shows it in the list

requirements.statement: A user can delete a todo

criteria.must: Deleting a todo removes it from the caller's list

requirements.statement: A user can sign out of the app

criteria.must: Signing out ends the session and returns the user to the sign-in step
After signing out, the user's todos are no longer visible without signing in again

requirements.statement: A todo is private to the user who created it, with no sharing or team lists

criteria.must: One user cannot see another user's todos
